description_en: A low bench formed by a woven rectangular storage chest with a cushioned hinged lid; the front shows the chest wall and plain recessed pull, the side reveals lid hinges and thick rim, and the rear shows two hinge mounts and ventilated woven panels. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.

All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact RIGHT-SIDE ELEVATION: orbit camera 90 degrees to the object's right from its canonical front, level with product center. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins.
